title: Asymmetric dual response
claim: The asymmetric dual-response equation improves prediction on two reserved contiguous Rabi blocks compared with the single-line and polynomial controls. Its practical contribution is a scoped response surrogate with explicit uncertainty about mechanism, not a new atomic law.
scope: Entire contiguous probe-Rabi blocks; one vapor cell. No independent atomic-cell replication.
limitations: Public source-aware confirmation is now exposed.
Predictive success does not prove a causal mechanism, exhaustive novelty, or realized industrial impact.
Alternative valid equations are admissible under the same task.
Both width intercepts w0 and n0 reach the imposed 0.1 MHz lower bound; intrinsic zero-power linewidths are not identified.

title: Mechanistic or transfer falsification
claim: A single saturating line fails to explain the response as well as the two-sign line-shape family.
rationale: The failed single-line candidate has larger grouped development and confirmation error; the result does not uniquely prove two microscopic channels.
scope: The tested equations and current data only; no claim of universal impossibility.
